title: Region pin training lab: scenarios and exercise pack
content:
Purpose:
This is a hands-on training kit for oncall / SRE / deployment engineers and solutions engineers to practice region pin enforcement, fallback behavior, and evidence packaging under controlled conditions. The lab is meant to be delivered as a 2.5 hour instructor‑led workshop with breakouts. Use this to validate operator runbooks, dashboard coverage, and customer comm scripts before rolling enforcement to a new cohort of tenants.

Audience:
- Oncall engineers (primary operators)
- Platform SRE (facilitator & telemetry owner)
- Solutions Eng / Customer Success (customer persona role)
- Legal/compliance observer (optional)

Learning objectives (high level):
- Verify pin enforcement actions (soft-pin vs hard-pin) and understand observable differences in traces, logs, metrics.
- Practice collecting auditable evidence bundles (request logs, routing decisions, region metadata) within 15 minutes of an incident.
- Execute safe fallback and rollback with minimal customer impact and validate rollback telemetry.
- Run post‑exercise debrief and produce an actionable ticket with remediation owner and timeline.

Setup & prework (30–45 min before workshop):
- Provision lab tenant(s) in staging cluster with test customer metadata (tenant_id lab-XXX, region=eu-west-1, allowed_regions=[eu-west-1])
- Ensure operator sandbox role has ability to flip region_pin enforcement flag and trigger capacity throttling.
- Load synthetic traffic generator with two test flows: low-latency interactive chat (60 req/min) and bulk embedding ingestion (1k requests over 10 minutes).
- Confirm dashboards: per-tenant routing trace, model selection count, failed-route counter, region-evidence-upload metric.
- Slack channel #lab-region-pin, recording enabled for facilitator notes.

Exercise A — Soft enforcement mock (45 min)
Goal: Practice detecting misrouted requests during a soft-pin period and collect evidence without evicting tenant traffic.
Steps for facilitator:
1) Announce start time T0. Enable soft-pin policy for lab-tenant via admin UI (policy=soft).
2) Introduce simulated downstream latency in eu-west-1 (add 250ms to serving path) but keep capacity intact.
3) Start synthetic traffic. Operators should monitor routing traces and notice fallback to compatible variant in us-west-2 for non-sensitive workloads.
Operator tasks:
- Locate first misroute trace, capture trace id, collect map of request->region at time window T0..T0+5m.
- Create evidence bundle (request ids list, routingDecision logs, tenant pin metadata snapshot). Aim to assemble within 15 minutes.
- Draft a short customer note (2–3 bullets) explaining observed behavior and planned mitigation.
Expected signals & success criteria:
- Dashboard shows increase in routingDecision=alternate-region events by >=5% within 5 minutes.
- Evidence bundle contains at least 10 request ids and corresponding routing logs.
- Customer note drafted and reviewed by solutions eng.
Failure modes to practice:
- Evidence incomplete (missing routing logs) — practice data retention retrieval steps.
- Operator cannot find trace due to log sampling — practice increasing sampling and re-run generator.

Exercise B — Hard enforcement during capacity saturation (50 min)
Goal: Practice eviction escalation, SLA impact assessment, and rapid rollback with minimal customer notice.
Setup adjustments:
- Flip policy to hard-pin for lab-tenant and enable capacity throttle to simulate GPU shortage in eu-west-1.
- Synthetic traffic burst to exceed capacity by ~2.5x sustained for 8 minutes.
Operator tasks:
- Observe fail counters, error rates, and queue depth metrics.
- Decide and execute one of two actions (with facilitator permission): 1) enact immediate auto-eviction to alternate-region variant, or 2) roll forward mitigation (increase burst capacity).
- If eviction chosen: perform evidence packaging and post a customer incident note using the template below.
Expected signals & success criteria:
- Errors due to capacity should correlate with tenant_id in traces and show backpressure.
- If eviction executed, completion of eviction choreography within 6 minutes and verification that traffic is served from fallback region for >=95% of requests in next 2 minutes.
- Post-incident ticket created and assigned with remediation owner and SLA impact summary.
Split testing & safe rollback notes:
- Testers should prefer a canary eviction on a small percentage of sessions first (10%) before full eviction in non-training environments.
- Rollback: re-enable region routing and clear eviction flags; validate no residual throttling.

Exercise C — Audit evidence collection & packaging (30 min)
Goal: Ensure evidence bundle meets compliance checklist for audit requests.
Evidence checklist:
- Tenant routing history CSV (timestamp, request_id, source_ip, route_region, model_variant)
- System snapshot (config: region_pin flag value, policy version, operator actions with timestamps)
- Signed narrative (operator summary, steps taken, time windows)
- Supporting telemetry (dashboards: cpu/gpu utilization, queue depth graphs)
Operator task:
- Produce completed evidence bundle and upload to secure evidence bucket (simulate with staging S3).
Success criteria:
- Bundle uploaded and accessible to compliance observer.
- Bundle includes at least 2 corroborating telemetry screens and operator narrative.

Debrief & grading rubric (20–30 min)
Rubric (pass/fail with notes):
- Detection: operator identified the anomalous routing within target window (pass if <=8 minutes).
- Evidence: bundle completeness (pass if >=80% of checklist items present).
- Communication: customer note and ticket created (pass if both created within 20 minutes of first detection).
- Remediation: correct rollback or eviction procedure executed without causing cross-tenant impact (pass if no collateral alerts triggered).
Facilitator scoring: assign R/G/Y per category and capture improvement actions as tickets.

Facilitator & operator cheat-sheet (one-pagers to print)
- Quick commands: admin flag toggles (cli snippets), evidence export commands, sample queries for trace id lookup.
- Dashboard shortcuts: where to find per-tenant routing heatmap, failed-route histogram, model-selection counters.
- Escalation matrix: when to call SRE lead, when to loop in solutions eng, when legal must be informed.

Artifacts to produce after the lab:
- Short postmortem template (summary, timeline, root cause hypothesis, action items)
- Evidence bundle link + verification note
- Improvements backlog ticket with owner and ETA

Open questions & TODOs (for doc owners):
- Automate evidence bundle collection (idea: button in admin UI that compiles the checklist).
- Small-scale canary tool for soft->hard escalation to reduce blast radius.
- Add automated test to CI that validates evidence bundle completeness for staging exercises.

Instructor notes (practical tips):
- Keep a stopwatch for each exercise; enforce timeboxes strictly so team gets through all scenarios.
- Encourage role swapping (operator ↔ solutions eng) so each participant sees both sides.
- Record the session and capture dashboards screenshots immediately after each exercise — ephemeral telemetry can be lost otherwise.

Appendix: quick customer communication templates
- Short alert (for soft-pin anomalies): "We observed a small number of requests routed outside your pinned region due to transient performance issues in EU-West-1. No data left your permitted regions for sensitive workloads; we are monitoring and will follow up with evidence."
- Escalation notice (after hard eviction): "We temporarily redirected traffic from EU-West-1 to a verified fallback region to maintain availability. We are compiling the routing evidence and will share a full packet within 24 hours along with mitigation steps."

Sample training schedule (2.5 hours):
- 00:00–00:15 precheck & setup verification
- 00:15–01:00 Exercise A (soft enforcement)
- 01:00–01:10 break + reset
- 01:10–02:00 Exercise B (hard enforcement)
- 02:00–02:20 Exercise C (evidence packaging)
- 02:20–02:50 Debrief & grading

Contact & ownership:
- Lab owner: Maya Kapoor (eng-private-deployments)
- Suggested reviewers: Jordan Li (SRE), Priya Nair (solutions eng), Claire Dubois (legal advisor)

Notes: this is a practical working draft. Add sample CLI snippets and admin UI walkthrough in a follow-up doc. Keep iterations short — we expect multiple revisions after first classroom run.
